players.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
players.note: Thornton (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Bills,  Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Elijah Arroyo
players.note: Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed with reporters Monday that Arroyo will miss "significant time" due to a shoulder injury that he picked up during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

players.name: Trevor Etienne
players.note: Etienne (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

players.name: Velus Jones Jr.
players.note: Jones turned four carries into 20 yards and caught his only target for minus-1 yard during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Sampson (knee) won't be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's contest against the Ravens, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Isaiah Davis
players.note: Davis rushed seven times for 16 yards and caught his only target for 10 yards during Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.

players.name: Emari Demercado
players.note: Demercado (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday night's matchup with the Packers, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: Bryant (ankle) was placed on the Broncos' injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Claiborne carried the ball three times for 12 yards during Minnesota's win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

players.name: Tua Tagovailoa
players.note: With Michael Penix (ribs) cleared to play Sunday against the Bears, Tagovailoa will handle backup duties for the Falcons.

players.name: Bam Knight
players.note: Knight rushed 15 times for 80 yards and caught both of his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

players.name: James Conner
players.note: Conner (foot) is close to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Beck (coach's decision) is inactive and is designated as Arizona's emergency third quarterback for Sunday's matchup versus the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.note: The Eagles have downgraded Stowers (quadriceps) to out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.note: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Cardinals on Sunday.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
players.note: Daniels completed 22 of 43 passes for 164 yards and one touchdown with two interceptions in Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to the Steelers. He added 39 rushing yards on four carries.

players.name: Tyson Bagent
players.note: With Caleb Williams (hamstring) active, Tyson Bagent will serve as the Bears' backup quarterback against the Falcons on Sunday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Blake Grupe
players.note: Rams head coach Sean McVay announced Monday that Grupe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn ACL in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

players.name: Josh Oliver
players.note: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Hollywood Brown
players.note: NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports that teams seeking help at wide receiver will likely call the Eagles about the status of Brown before the Nov. 10 deadline.

players.name: Colbie Young
players.note: questionable

players.name: Alec Ingold
players.note: The Chargers placed Ingold on injured reserve Thursday due to a shoulder injury.

players.name: Tyrod Taylor
players.note: Taylor played the final two snaps of Sunday's 31-7 win over the Bears, losing two yards on a pair of kneeldowns.

players.name: Tyler Huntley
players.note: Huntley completed 19 of 31 passes for 165 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and added five rushes for 28 yards in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

players.name: Carsen Ryan
players.note: Ryan (calf) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Reggie Virgil
players.note: Virgil recorded two receptions for 29 yards on five targets in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

players.name: Braxton Berrios
players.note: Berrios (foot) underwent successful surgery Friday to repair a Lisfranc injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Skyy Moore
players.note: The Packers placed Moore (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Andy Dalton
players.note: Dalton agreed to a one-year contract with the Falcons on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: David Sills V
players.note: Sills (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Grant Calcaterra
players.note: The Eagles downgraded Calcaterra (back) to out Saturday for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.note: Johnson rushed 13 times for 51 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-23 win over the Falcons. He caught both of his targets for 34 yards.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.note: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Sunday.

players.name: Audric Estime
players.note: Estime turned nine carries into 19 yards and a touchdown during the Browns' 13-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

players.name: David Martin-Robinson
players.note: Martin-Robinson (hamstring) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.note: Wayne was claimed off waivers by the Dolphins on Tuesday.

players.name: Carter Runyon
players.note: Runyon (lower body) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jackson Meeks
players.note: Meeks (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Arizona.

players.name: Justin Joly
players.note: questionable

players.name: Cole Payton
players.note: Payton is active as the backup to starting quarterback Tanner McKee in Sunday's game against the Panthers.

players.name: Nick Vannett
players.note: Vannett (knee) practiced in full Thursday.

players.name: Zach Ertz
players.note: Ertz is not being elevated from the practice squad for Sunday's matchup against Carolina, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brandon McManus
players.note: McManus is slated to sign with the Rams, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Tanner Hudson
players.note: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

players.name: Pharaoh Brown
players.note: Brown was signed to the 53-man roster Tuesday.

players.name: Tom Kennedy
players.note: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Lew Nichols
players.note: The Steelers signed Nichols off their practice squad Saturday.
